verdict.rationale: The evidence shows an API reference page that points to open-source SDKs, a published OpenAPI spec, and static SDK code snippets in the dashboard and on the marketing site. Nothing shows an interactive reference where users can run requests or a 'try it' API explorer. A static reference plus an OpenAPI file is an adjacent building block, not the interactive, runnable experience the story asks for.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples
